The evolution from 2023 to 2026 has basically been a journey of removing bottlenecks. First it was context window limitations, then it was reasoning and tool-calling reliability, and now it’s retrieval and ingestion. An agent is only as smart as the data it can actually access and understand. Jumping into these slides to see how the patterns have matured!

This is the kind of mindset that will matter in the AI era. The most impressive part wasn’t the stack itself ,it was the willingness to sit down, build, experiment, and understand the technology personally instead of consuming polished summaries about it.
